faq.title: Got a question? We've got the answer
faq.subtitle: The most common questions we get from our clients about Special Cards

q0.a: Special Cards is a platform specialized in designing and sending distinctive digital invitations for weddings and occasions. It helps you create invitations easily, send them via WhatsApp and text messages, track attendance statistics, and send automatic reminders.

q1.q: How can I create a new invitation?
q1.a: You can create a new invitation through the Special Cards app. Choose the right number of invitations, add your event details, and invite your guests. The app is available on the App Store and Google Play.

q2.q: Can I add my own custom design?
q2.a: Of course, you can provide us with any custom design of your own.

q3.q: Can I see the details of RSVPs and attendance?
q3.a: Yes, you'll get an overall attendance summary along with a detailed list containing guest names and phone numbers.

q4.q: Can reminders be sent to guests?
q4.a: Yes, Special Cards automatically sends a reminder to all guests one day before the event. You can also send extra reminders whenever needed.

q5.q: What is the compensatory credit system?
q5.a: Compensatory credit means that if a guest declines, you get a free replacement invitation you can use to invite someone else.

q6.q: Can I assign more than one additional host?
q6.a: Yes, you can assign more than one additional host. For example, you can allocate specific invitations to the groom's family, and you'll still see comprehensive statistics across all invitations.

q7.q: Are invitations sent to each guest by their personal name?
q7.a: Yes, the invitation message shows each guest's name personally.

q8.q: Do all invitations reach the recipients?
q8.a: Yes, God willing, all invitations reach recipients whether via WhatsApp or text message.

q9.q: What about guests who don't use WhatsApp?
q9.a: No worries, they'll receive the invitation via text message instead of WhatsApp.

q10.q: Can I invite guests from outside Saudi Arabia?
q10.a: Yes, you can invite guests from anywhere in the world.

q11.q: Is my data safe with Special Cards?
q11.a: The security of your data is our top priority. We use the latest encryption and protection technologies to ensure the privacy of your information and your guests' data. All data is protected and never shared with any third party.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At {{siteName}}, we respect your privacy and are committed to handling your personal data responsibly and transparently. This policy briefly explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.

section1.title: 1. Data We Collect
section1.intro: We may collect the data necessary to provide our services, such as:
section1.item5: Guest data entered by the user to use the invitation and attendance-management services.
section1.item6: Some technical data needed to operate the platform and improve your experience.
section1.note: We are careful to collect only the data necessary, and only to the extent related to its intended purpose.

section2.title: 2. Use of Data
section2.intro: We use data for purposes related to {{siteName}}'s services, including:
section2.item2: Sending invitations and tracking RSVP confirmations.
section2.item4: Providing reports and features related to the event.
section2.item5: Communicating with you about your requests and our services.
section2.item7: Complying with regulatory requirements when needed.

section3.title: 3. Guest Data
section3.p1: When using our guest-management services, data specific to your event's guests may be added.
section3.p2: This data is used to provide services related to the invitation and attendance management, and only within the scope of the purpose for which it was collected.
section3.p3: The user is responsible for ensuring they have the right to enter and use guest data in accordance with the relevant regulatory requirements.

section4.title: 4. Data Sharing
section4.p1: We do not sell personal data or use it for marketing purposes unrelated to our services.
section4.p2: Some data may be processed through supporting service providers when needed to operate the platform's functions, only to the extent necessary to provide the service and in accordance with the relevant regulatory requirements.

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.p1: We retain data for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which it was collected, or for the period required by regulatory obligations.
section5.p2: Once data is no longer needed, it is handled in accordance with approved deletion or destruction procedures, taking into account any regulatory retention requirements.

section6.title: 6. Data Protection
section6.p1: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to help protect personal data from unauthorized access or use, in line with the nature of the data and services provided.

section7.title: 7. Your Rights
section7.intro: In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations, you may have a number of rights regarding your personal data, including the right to request:
section7.item1: Knowing how your data is used.
section7.item4: Deleting your data in the cases permitted by law.
section7.item5: Withdrawing consent, where consent is the legal basis for processing.
section7.note: You can contact us to exercise your rights or to inquire about how your data is handled.

section8.title: 8. Updates to This Privacy Policy
section8.p1: We may update this policy from time to time to keep up with any changes in our services or regulatory requirements.
section8.p2: The updated version will be published on this page, with the last-updated date indicated.

clause1.label: First
clause1.body: If the agreed deposit has been paid and the client then cancels the booking definitively before the scheduled event date, please note that the paid deposit is non-refundable, whether the deposit was paid by bank transfer or through the store.

clause2.label: Second
clause2.body: If the client makes changes to an entry card — whether to the guest's name, the QR code, or otherwise — the card will be permanently disabled in the system, and we disclaim any responsibility arising from that.

clause3.label: Third
clause3.body: If official orders are issued by the competent authorities to cancel or postpone events and celebrations due to epidemics, viruses, natural disasters, or similar circumstances, the client is entitled — if they wish to postpone the event to another date — to have the event's day and date changed free of charge, provided the venue location is not changed.

clause4.label: Fourth
clause4.body: If the cards have already been issued by the system and the client wishes to postpone the event, change the event venue, change the invitation design, or add an edit to the invitation card, new invitations will be issued according to the client's request for a separate additional amount, without refunding the amount for the previous invitations — since the previous invitations already had their codes (QR feature) issued by the system.

clause5.label: Fifth
clause5.body: If the barcodes for the client's guests have already been issued and the client then cancels the event definitively for any reason, the client is obligated to pay the remaining balance of the full invoice.

clause6.label: Sixth
clause6.body: The invoice will be issued by the finance department three days before the event, and the client is required to settle the remaining amount as soon as the invoice is issued; after that, no further guests may be added for the client.

clause7.label: Seventh
clause7.body: The assignment of male and female supervisors to events and occasions is determined by the supervisors department, not according to the client's preference.

clause8.label: Eighth
clause8.body: After the event has concluded, {{siteName}} is entitled to publish the client's design on Instagram, the store, and other social media platforms.
